implementation_details.workspace_fence: Binding additionally stores immutable workspace_token+workspace_generation, both included in its full immutable binding digest. Ordered principal->project guard->membership NOWAIT->job->binding->workspace intent SHARE->outbox locks prevent validated READY identity changing before projection commit. G5 locks only intent and does not acquire earlier classes.
implementation_details.workspace_recovery: ERROR/RESERVED/PROVISIONING are wait and never apply. A READY intent recovered with a changed generation after binding reservation is an identity conflict and quarantines without relinking or projection. Same committed receipt replays before any later workspace/revocation checks. Automatic binding migration/unquarantine is not implemented or accepted; explicit future operator recovery contract is required.
implementation_details.command_bytes: Existing G4 rejects NUL strings with422/INVALID_REQUEST; preserve it and assert zero new job/command rows. Existing G4 accepts supported lone-surrogate/astral semantic text (historical named G4 case), so do not decode/re-serialize the full stored canonical ASCII command in PostgreSQL JSON processing. Hash the fixed original format/payload envelope directly over exact immutable bytes. Verify the contiguous canonical encoded profile_version/project_id/release_mode field boundary using known catalog profile-version JSON and the independently encoded project ID. This relies on trusted G4 strict fixed keys/sorted compact ASCII and immutable commands; embedded user quotes are escaped and cannot forge that raw field boundary. It is not a general JSON/schema validator; changing the DTO/canonicalization or including malicious runtime-credential writers requires a new reviewed boundary. No raw body enters Temporal.
